title: Clinic websites lose bookings

slides.heading: Why clinic websites lose bookings
slides.body: Small issues on the homepage can send patients to another clinic.

slides.heading: Slow pages stop bookings
slides.body: If your site loads slowly, people leave before they see your services.

slides.heading: Missing details create doubt
slides.body: Hours, location, and contact info should be easy to find in one glance.

slides.heading: Phones need the shortest path
slides.body: Most visitors are on mobile, so the booking path should take only a few taps.

slides.heading: Clarity beats extra design
slides.body: A clear website helps people decide faster than a fancy one with hidden actions.

slides.heading: Get a free review
slides.body: Send your website link and get three fixes you can make this week.

caption:
Clinic websites often lose bookings for simple reasons.
Slow pages, hidden details, and weak mobile flow push people away.
